basis: A coarse small voltage-amplifier task: 10 mV peak-to-peak input, 60 mV peak-to-peak output, not precision audio. 10 mV peak is retained as a separate distortion challenge; resistor designs exceeded 2% there. No Local target seen.

resources.boundary: Includes all physical reference, bias and signal branches; common ideal Vdd and Vin ports with 1 kohm source resistance. Port-delivered current/power counted, external source implementation cost unknown. MOS drawn area is not total layout area; resistor area/parasitics unknown.

scope: Local accuracy and deterministic condition changes. No noise limit; nominal noise reported. Dynamic behavior measured on a declared finite subset in confirmation; no all-population joint-pass claim.
